---
title: "Zeroed rule files"
---

Crosslink retains `.crosslink/rules/*.md` as active loader paths. Every bundled
file is zero bytes in this release. The rule hook and provider registrations are
still present; only the shipped Markdown content has been removed.

## Why the paths remain

Older Crosslink releases installed behavioral and language text at these paths.
Keeping zero-byte replacements lets `crosslink init --update` remove that content
while preserving manifest ownership, loader behavior, and predictable upgrades.

The filenames cover the former global, project, tracking-mode, web, and
language-specific surfaces. The loader still recognizes those filenames, so a
future or local nonempty file is routed through the same established mechanism.

## Tracking configuration

Set `tracking_mode` in `.crosslink/hook-config.json` to choose `strict`, `normal`,
or `relaxed` repository checks. Operational enforcement reads configuration
directly, while the prompt hook continues to resolve the matching Markdown path.

## Verification

```bash
crosslink context check
crosslink init --update --dry-run
```

`crosslink context check` verifies the rule and hook deployment. `crosslink init
--update` replaces managed legacy rule content with empty files.
